name: Pixel
source: Somewhere under 4'11" tall, Android began as a Mk-1 Civilian Service Android 25-30 years ago. Eventually she ended up in a recycling center, where her memories were wiped. The player's grandfather then bought her for cheap. He began working on her with the goal of creating consciousness, and to prove AI was more than just a tool. Ellen said he worked from morning to night, and along the way he got the idea to write countless loops to imitate mutations like in the evolution of organic species. Kali eventually looks at her code and tells her she has 937,000,000 lines of code, about 10 times a normal android, and "Almost 94,000 errors." Grandfather worked more on her code, but her hard coding corrects foreign programs to restore it to its default in a slowing curve, which would eventually remove his changes and return her to factory default, thus removing her consciousness. He deeply regretted not being able to get around this, distraught that his new daughter of sorts will die some day. So he completed her body and gave her some clothes, introducing her to Ellen but shutting her off after admitting her existence would be confusing to others, and never turned her on again, wiping her memory so she wouldn't remember him when he died. Despite her physical age, Android has only experienced around 2 months of real time when she becomes an official member of the Hotel.
